category_observations.observation: ENTRY, REVERSE and PINCH show an open central floor and separated OCRU/restart/decon/recovery working zones. This is image readability evidence, not numerical route or unchanged-layout verification.

The OCRU frame, carriage, guarded restart buttons, framed cabinets and berth have object-specific secondary construction. The angular simplification and muted lavender/navy/orange family relate coherently to the approved spawn references.

category_observations.category: OCRU hero function and focal clarity
category_observations.observation: The red OCRU bed and cavity dominate ENTRY, WALL_WEST and HERO_OCRU. The surrounding controls and support structure remain visible. The underbed bag remains low-contrast and subordinate in the inspected OCRU views.

DETAIL_OCRU, DETAIL_SUPPLIES and HERO_RECOVERY distinguish restrained metal, soft bedding, bottles, paper and painted surfaces without pervasive shiny plastic or photographic noise. Some small furnishings are visually pristine and orderly.

The dark ceiling and secondary stations frame a localized red OCRU focus and warm supply workbench zone. HERO_RESERVE and HERO_DECON are especially dim but their main functional shapes remain identifiable in their actual images.

category_observations.category: Purposeful dressing and neglected workplace story
category_observations.observation: The authoritarian continuity/productivity poster, denied shift log, empty cartridge slot, sparse floor remnants and closed underbed bag support the clinic story. Tool and bottle placement remains very orderly, so age and neglect are more understated than the harsh lighting and institutional narrative.

noncritical_findings.finding: Several clinical props remain neatly aligned and surfaces are relatively pristine. The bleak mood reads more strongly than everyday neglect.
noncritical_findings.suggested_correction: On a future complete source, judge whether a small localized handling mark or one interrupted task would improve neglect without adding random debris or blanket grime.

noncritical_findings.finding: The darkest secondary stations lose some peripheral edge and surface information. Their central contents are still identifiable in these inspected views.
